name: Laptops and desktops
desc: Standard laptops, desktop PCs and office workstations for employees, including factory warranty; not multi-screen trading desk workstations: see Trading desk workstations.

name: Monitors and displays
desc: Desktop monitors, portable screens and large-format office displays for desks and open areas; not meeting room video bars or trading floor screen arrays.

name: Peripherals and accessories
desc: Keyboards, mice, docking stations, headsets, webcams and cables for laptops and desktops; not phone cases or chargers: see Mobile device accessories.

name: Thin clients and zero clients
desc: Thin and zero client terminals used to reach virtual desktops in branches, call centres and offices; not the virtual desktop software itself.

name: Meeting room AV hardware
desc: Video bars, room cameras, speakerphones, room control panels and interactive whiteboards for meeting rooms; not video conferencing subscriptions or installation: see Telecom and IT services.

name: Smartphones and mobile phones
desc: Corporate smartphones and basic mobile handsets bought outright or on device lease; not mobile airtime or data plans: see Mobile voice and data.

name: Tablets and 2-in-1 devices
desc: Tablets and 2-in-1 detachable devices for advisers, executives and branch staff, including pens and keyboard covers bought together with the device.

name: Mobile device accessories
desc: Phone and tablet cases, screen protectors, chargers, power banks and car mounts for corporate mobile devices; not laptop peripherals: see Peripherals and accessories.

name: Multifunction printers and copiers
desc: Office multifunction printers, copiers and desktop laser printers, bought or leased as devices; not paper or toner: see Printer paper and toner.

name: Specialist printers
desc: Card, passbook, receipt, label and badge printers used in branches, card centres and mailrooms; not office multifunction printers or copiers.

name: Document and cheque scanners
desc: Desktop and production document scanners, cheque scanners and ID document readers for branches and back office; not outsourced scanning operations: see Business process services.

name: Data centre servers
desc: Rack, blade and high-density servers, including GPU servers for AI workloads, bought for on-premise data centres; not cloud compute: see Cloud and hosting.

name: Storage arrays
desc: Enterprise SAN, NAS and all-flash storage arrays with their expansion shelves and controllers; not backup appliances or tape libraries: see Backup and tape hardware.

name: Backup and tape hardware
desc: Tape libraries, tape drives, cartridges and purpose-built backup appliances for on-premise data protection; not backup software licences: see Backup and recovery software.

name: Racks, power and KVM equipment
desc: Server racks, rack PDUs, KVM switches, cable management and rack-mounted UPS units for data centres and comms rooms; not building power or cooling works.

name: Network switches and routers
desc: LAN switches, core and branch routers, load balancer appliances and optics for office and data centre networks; not WAN connectivity: see Telecom.

name: Wireless network equipment
desc: Wi-Fi access points, wireless controllers, antennas and indoor mobile signal boosters for offices and branches; not mobile network subscriptions.

name: Firewalls and security appliances
desc: Hardware firewalls, VPN concentrators and intrusion prevention appliances bought as physical boxes; not standalone security software: see Infrastructure and security software.

name: Hardware security modules
desc: Payment and general-purpose hardware security modules for cryptographic key storage, PIN processing and card issuing, installed in the bank's data centres.

name: Trading desk workstations
desc: High-performance trader workstations, multi-screen arrays, screen mounts and video extenders for trading desks; not standard office laptops and desktops.

name: Low-latency and timing hardware
desc: Ultra-low-latency switches, FPGA network cards, PTP grandmaster clocks and packet capture appliances for electronic trading; not general office network switches.

name: Software licences, installed (other)
desc: Perpetual or term licences for on-premise software not covered by a function-specific category, such as niche desktop tools; not SaaS subscriptions: see Software as a service (other).

name: Software as a service (other)
desc: Cloud software subscriptions not covered by a function-specific category, such as niche web tools; not cloud infrastructure: see Cloud and hosting.

name: CRM software
desc: Customer relationship software for sales, relationship managers and client teams, including pipeline tracking and client contact history, delivered as SaaS or installed.

name: HR and payroll software
desc: Software for HR records, recruiting, performance reviews, learning administration and payroll calculation; not outsourced payroll processing: see Business process services.

name: Finance and ERP software
desc: ERP, general ledger, financial consolidation, planning and expense software for the finance function; not ERP implementation: see IT services.

name: Procurement and source-to-pay software
desc: Sourcing, e-procurement, supplier onboarding, purchase-to-pay and spend analytics software; not contract repositories: see Contract lifecycle management software.

name: Contract lifecycle management software
desc: Software to draft, negotiate, approve, store and track obligations of contracts across legal and procurement; not e-signature on its own: see E-signature software.

name: Document and records management software
desc: Enterprise content, document repository and records retention software, including electronic archiving and legal hold; not physical archive storage: see Facilities.

name: Workflow and process orchestration software
desc: Workflow, BPM, robotic process automation and low-code app-building software that automates approvals, cases and hand-offs; not ticketing tools: see IT service management software.

name: Collaboration and productivity software
desc: Office suites, email, team chat, video meeting, intranet and online whiteboard software for employees; not meeting room hardware or telephony.

name: Customer communication software
desc: Software for customer correspondence, statement composition, omnichannel messaging, chatbots and contact centre agent desktops; not print and mail outsourcing: see Business process services.

name: E-signature software
desc: Electronic and qualified electronic signature software for signing customer and internal documents, including eIDAS trust service subscriptions for remote signing.

name: Core banking software
desc: Core banking software for deposit accounts, customer ledgers, interest calculation and product configuration; not core banking migration projects: see IT services.

name: Digital banking software
desc: Online and mobile banking front-end software for retail and corporate customers, including banking apps and corporate portals; not app development projects.

name: Payments software
desc: Payment hubs, SEPA and instant payment engines, SWIFT messaging interfaces and payment repair software; not SWIFT network or scheme fees: see Financial market infrastructure.

name: Card issuing and processing software
desc: Software for card issuing, authorisation, card lifecycle and acquiring processing; not card scheme fees: see Financial market infrastructure; not card printers.

name: Trading and order management software
desc: Order and execution management, electronic trading, pricing and trade capture software for front-office trading desks; not market data feeds: see Market data and research.

name: Securities post-trade software
desc: Software for trade confirmation, settlement, custody, corporate actions and collateral processing in securities and derivatives; not outsourced settlement operations.

name: Market and credit risk software
desc: Software for market risk, counterparty credit risk, credit portfolio and capital calculations such as VaR, CVA and RWA; not GRC or operational risk tools.

name: Treasury and ALM software
desc: Treasury, liquidity, funding and asset-liability management software, including cash forecasting and interest rate risk in the banking book.

name: Regulatory reporting software
desc: Software producing prudential and statistical regulatory returns such as COREP, FINREP, AnaCredit and transaction reporting; not trade repository fees: see Financial market infrastructure.

name: AML transaction monitoring software
desc: Software that detects suspicious transactions and generates anti-money laundering alerts and cases; not alert review operations: see Business process services.

name: Sanctions screening software
desc: Name and payment screening software that matches customers and transactions against sanctions and PEP lists; not the list data itself: see Market data and research.

name: Fraud detection software
desc: Software for real-time payment, card and online banking fraud detection, device fingerprinting and behavioural biometrics; not cyber security monitoring: see Security monitoring and SIEM software.

name: KYC and client onboarding software
desc: Software for customer due diligence, identity verification, document capture and client onboarding journeys; not outsourced KYC reviews: see Business process services.

name: Lending and loan origination software
desc: Software for loan origination, credit decisioning, mortgage processing and loan servicing across retail and corporate lending; not credit rating data.

name: Wealth and portfolio management software
desc: Software for private banking advice, portfolio construction, rebalancing, investment suitability and client reporting for wealth and asset management clients.

name: Governance, risk and compliance software
desc: GRC software for policies, controls testing, operational risk events, internal audit and third-party risk assessments; not market or credit risk engines.

name: BI and reporting software
desc: Business intelligence, dashboarding, self-service analytics and report distribution software; not regulatory returns: see Regulatory reporting software.

name: Data platform and warehouse software
desc: Data warehouse, lakehouse, data integration and ETL software for storing and moving analytical data; not operational databases: see Database software.

name: Data quality and governance software
desc: Data catalogue, lineage, data quality monitoring, master data and metadata software supporting BCBS 239 and data ownership; not data consulting.

name: AI and machine learning software
desc: Machine learning model development, MLOps, model monitoring and feature store software for predictive models; not large language model tools: see Generative AI software.

name: Generative AI software
desc: Large language model subscriptions, AI assistants, coding copilots and retrieval-augmented generation tools for employees and developers; not AI consulting: see Consulting.

name: Statistical and modelling software
desc: Statistical analysis, quantitative modelling and numerical computing software used by risk, actuarial and quant teams; not model validation services.

name: Operating system and virtualisation software
desc: Server and desktop operating systems, hypervisors, container orchestration and virtual desktop infrastructure software; not thin client hardware.

name: Database software
desc: Relational, NoSQL and in-memory database software and database tooling for operational applications; not analytical warehouses: see Data platform and warehouse software.

name: Middleware and integration software
desc: API gateways, message queues, event streaming, enterprise service bus and managed file transfer software connecting applications; not data warehouse ETL tools.

name: Endpoint and email security software
desc: Antivirus, endpoint detection and response, email filtering, data loss prevention and encryption software; not managed detection operations: see Cyber security services.

name: Security monitoring and SIEM software
desc: SIEM, security log analytics, vulnerability scanning and threat intelligence software operated by the bank's own team; not outsourced SOC: see Cyber security services.

name: Identity and access management software
desc: Single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, privileged access, identity governance and access recertification software; not identity consulting or managed identity operations.

name: Monitoring and observability software
desc: Application performance monitoring, infrastructure monitoring, log aggregation and alerting software for IT operations; not security event monitoring: see Security monitoring and SIEM software.

name: Backup and recovery software
desc: Backup, snapshot, replication and disaster recovery orchestration software licensed for on-premise or cloud workloads; not backup hardware or backup as a service.

name: Device management software
desc: Unified endpoint and mobile device management software for enrolling, configuring, patching and remotely wiping laptops, phones and tablets.

name: Developer tools and CI/CD software
desc: IDEs, source control, CI/CD pipelines, artifact repositories and code quality scanners for engineering teams; not development projects: see Application development and maintenance.

name: Software testing tools
desc: Test automation, performance testing, test data generation and test case tracking tools; not outsourced testing projects: see IT services.

name: IT service management software
desc: ITSM tools for incident, change, problem and request handling, plus IT asset and licence tracking; not the outsourced service desk: see IT managed services.

name: Vendor software maintenance and support
desc: Annual maintenance, support and upgrade renewals paid to the original software vendor for licences the bank already owns.

name: Third-party software maintenance
desc: Independent third-party maintenance for vendor software after leaving the vendor's own maintenance, including patches and fixes for end-of-life versions.

name: Application development and maintenance
desc: Custom application build, enhancement and bug fixing by an external delivery team where no more specific application category fits; not software licences: see Software.

name: Web and mobile app development
desc: Design and build of customer-facing web portals and native or hybrid mobile banking apps, including front-end work and app store releases; not marketing websites: see Marketing.

name: Mainframe and legacy application services
desc: Maintenance and modernisation of mainframe and legacy applications such as COBOL, PL/I and batch jobs, including code conversion and replatforming.

name: Software testing and quality assurance
desc: Functional, regression, system integration and user acceptance testing delivered by an external test team; not testing tool licences: see Software.

name: Test automation
desc: Design and build of automated test frameworks and scripts for applications and APIs, including upkeep of automated regression suites.

name: Performance and load testing
desc: Performance, load, stress and capacity testing of applications and infrastructure before go-live or major releases; not penetration testing: see Cyber security services.

name: Systems integration and API development
desc: Build of interfaces, APIs, middleware integrations and event streaming between internal applications and third parties, including open banking and PSD2 APIs.

name: ERP and package implementation
desc: Implementation, configuration and upgrade of packaged business applications such as ERP, HR or CRM suites by a systems integrator; not core banking: see Core banking implementation.

name: Core banking implementation
desc: Implementation, configuration and upgrade of core banking, payments or lending packages by a systems integrator, including parallel runs and cutover.

name: Data migration
desc: Extraction, cleansing, mapping and loading of data from legacy into new applications, including reconciliation and migration dress rehearsals.

name: Low-code application development
desc: Build of workflow apps, forms and automations on low-code or robotic process automation tools by external developers; not the low-code licences: see Software.

name: DevOps and CI/CD engineering
desc: Set-up and engineering of build pipelines, infrastructure as code, containerisation and release automation for development teams.

name: IT managed services and service desk
desc: Outsourced service desk and multi-tower IT managed services under service levels, covering first-line user support and ticket handling across IT towers.

name: Managed workplace services
desc: Deskside and end-user computing services such as device provisioning, desktop engineering, patching and on-site smart hands; not buying laptops: see IT hardware.

name: Managed infrastructure operations
desc: Operation of on-premise servers, storage and virtualisation infrastructure by a third party under service levels; not public cloud: see Cloud and hosting.

name: Managed network operations
desc: Monitoring, configuration and operation of LAN, Wi-Fi, firewalls and routers by a network operations centre; not carrier circuits: see Telecom.

name: Application support and run
desc: Second and third-line support, monitoring and incident resolution for live business applications under service levels; not new development: see Application development and maintenance.

name: Database administration
desc: Remote or on-site administration, tuning, patching and upgrades of Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL and similar databases; not database licences: see Software.

name: Trading floor IT support
desc: Dedicated on-floor technical support for traders, covering desk moves, multi-screen setups, market data desktops and rapid fault fixing during market hours.

name: Managed print services
desc: Managed print fleet under a cost-per-page contract including consumables, servicing and print monitoring; not buying printers: see IT hardware.

name: Cyber security services
desc: General cyber security services and specialist resources not covered by a specific cyber category, such as security architecture, awareness campaigns and security engineering.

name: Penetration testing and red teaming
desc: Penetration tests of applications, networks and cloud, plus red team and threat-led exercises such as TIBER-EU and DORA TLPT.

name: Security operations centre and MDR
desc: Outsourced 24x7 security monitoring, SIEM operation, managed detection and response and alert triage; not SIEM licences: see Software.

name: Identity and access management services
desc: Implementation and operation of identity governance, privileged access, single sign-on and access recertification processes; not identity software licences: see Software.

name: Security assessments and audits
desc: Independent security maturity assessments, control reviews, cloud configuration reviews and third-party security due diligence; not penetration tests: see Penetration testing and red teaming.

name: Incident response and forensics
desc: Cyber incident response retainers, breach investigation, digital forensics and ransomware recovery assistance; not cyber insurance: see Insurance.

name: Threat intelligence services
desc: Cyber threat intelligence feeds and analyst reports, dark web monitoring and phishing domain takedowns; not sanctions or adverse media data: see Market data.

name: Data engineering and warehousing
desc: Build and operation of data pipelines, data warehouses and lakehouses, including ingestion, modelling and data platform engineering; not data platform licences: see Software.

name: Business intelligence and reporting development
desc: Design and build of dashboards, management information reports and self-service analytics models by external developers; not BI tool licences: see Software.

name: AI and machine learning engineering
desc: Development, deployment and monitoring of machine learning models and generative AI use cases such as chatbots, document extraction and copilots; not AI strategy advice: see Consulting.

name: Data governance and master data services
desc: Data quality remediation, data cataloguing, lineage documentation and master data stewardship carried out by an external team; not data strategy advice: see Consulting.

name: Hardware maintenance and repair
desc: Break-fix maintenance, spare parts and repair of servers, storage, network and end-user hardware, including third-party maintenance after vendor end of support.

name: IT asset disposal and data destruction
desc: Secure collection, certified data wiping, drive shredding, recycling and resale of retired IT equipment with certificates of destruction; not paper shredding: see Facilities.

name: IT equipment installation and cabling
desc: Installation of IT equipment, rack and stack, structured cabling and patching in offices and data centres; not building electrical works: see Facilities.

name: Device staging and logistics
desc: Imaging, kitting, warehousing and shipping of laptops and phones to employees, plus returns and swap logistics for remote workers.

name: Cloud infrastructure (IaaS and PaaS)
desc: Public cloud compute, storage, networking and managed platform services consumed pay-as-you-go or against committed spend; not SaaS applications: see Software.

name: Cloud marketplace purchases
desc: Third-party software and services bought through a public cloud marketplace and drawn down against cloud commitments; not direct SaaS subscriptions: see Software.

name: Managed cloud operations
desc: Third-party operation of our cloud tenancies, including landing zones, monitoring, patching, cost optimisation and cloud migrations; not on-premise operations: see IT services.

name: GPU and AI compute capacity
desc: Reserved or on-demand GPU capacity and hosted AI model inference consumed from cloud or specialist compute vendors; not AI development work: see IT services.

name: Data centre colocation
desc: Rack space, power, cooling and cross-connects in third-party data centres, including remote hands; not our own office buildings: see Facilities.

name: Managed hosting and private cloud
desc: Dedicated servers or single-tenant private cloud hosted and operated by a third party in its own data centre; not public cloud: see Cloud infrastructure.

name: Backup as a service
desc: Off-site and cloud backup of servers, databases and SaaS application data operated by a third party, including immutable and air-gapped copies.

name: Disaster recovery as a service
desc: Standby recovery environments and replication with tested failover for critical applications, delivered as a subscription; not business continuity consulting: see Consulting.

name: Content delivery network and edge
desc: Content delivery, edge caching, DNS hosting, web application firewall and DDoS mitigation for internet-facing sites and apps; not website design: see Marketing.

name: Web hosting and domain registration
desc: Shared web hosting for small websites and microsites, domain name registration and renewals, and SSL certificates; not website content production: see Marketing.

name: Mobile voice and data
desc: Mobile phone subscriptions, data plans, roaming bundles and SIM or eSIM cards for employees; not the handsets themselves: see IT hardware.

name: IoT and M2M connectivity
desc: Machine-to-machine SIMs and IoT connectivity for ATMs, payment terminals, alarm panels and smart building sensors, usually priced per connection.

name: Fixed-line voice and SIP trunking
l3: Fixed voice and contact centre telephony
desc: Fixed telephone lines, SIP trunks, number porting and call minutes for offices and branches; not mobile subscriptions: see Mobile voice and data.

name: Contact centre telephony and IVR
l3: Fixed voice and contact centre telephony
desc: Inbound numbers, freephone, call routing and IVR telephony for customer contact centres; not outsourced contact centre agents: see Business process services.

name: WAN and MPLS connectivity
desc: Wide area network and MPLS circuits linking branches, offices and data centres, including carrier-managed routers; not internal LAN operations: see IT services.

name: SD-WAN connectivity
desc: Software-defined WAN overlay delivered by a carrier or network integrator, including edge devices, orchestration and bundled underlay connectivity.

name: Internet access
desc: Dedicated internet access, business broadband and wireless backup links for offices, branches and data centres; not mobile phone plans: see Mobile voice and data.

name: Dark fibre and low-latency connectivity
desc: Dark fibre, wavelength and low-latency circuits to exchanges and trading venues, including microwave links for latency-sensitive trading.

name: Trading turrets and hoot-and-holler
desc: Trader voice turrets, private wires, hoot-and-holler and squawk boxes, including maintenance and dealer board moves; not general office telephony: see Fixed-line voice.

name: Voice and compliance call recording
desc: Recording, archiving and retrieval of trader and advisor calls and mobile communications for MiFID II record-keeping; not paper archive storage: see Facilities.

name: Video conferencing and meeting rooms
desc: Managed video conferencing rooms, telepresence suites and audio conferencing bridges; not collaboration software licences: see Software.

name: Unified communications and cloud telephony
desc: Cloud PBX, softphone calling, direct routing and operator connectivity into collaboration tools for employee voice; not trader voice: see Trading turrets and hoot-and-holler.

name: Real-time market data feeds
desc: Streaming real-time prices, quotes and order book data delivered by feed or API to trading and pricing applications; not terminals: see market data terminals.

name: Delayed and end-of-day market data
desc: Delayed quotes and end-of-day closing prices for internal reporting, websites and client statements, where real-time delivery is not needed.

name: Historical and tick data
desc: Archived time series, intraday tick history and historical price files for backtesting, model calibration and risk calculations; not live feeds.

name: Exchange market data licence fees
desc: Licence and usage fees charged by exchanges and trading venues for display, non-display and redistribution of their data; not membership or trading fees: see trading venue fees.

name: Market data terminals
desc: Desktop financial information terminals with prices, analytics, news and messaging for front-office and treasury users, including terminal seats and add-on modules.

name: Market data add-ins and web access
desc: Spreadsheet add-ins, web portals and mobile apps giving users access to market prices and company data without a full terminal seat.

name: Securities reference data
desc: Instrument master data such as identifiers, terms, classifications and listings for securities and derivatives; not prices: see evaluated pricing data.

name: Evaluated pricing data
desc: Independent end-of-day evaluated prices for bonds, loans and OTC derivatives used for valuation, price verification and fund accounting.

name: Corporate actions data
desc: Announcements and event data on dividends, coupons, splits, mergers and other corporate actions; not corporate actions processing: see payments and banking operations.

name: Legal entity and hierarchy data
desc: Legal entity identifiers, company hierarchies, ultimate parent and beneficial ownership data for counterparty, risk and regulatory reporting purposes.

name: Credit ratings data licences
desc: Licences to use credit agency ratings, outlooks and rating histories in risk, collateral and investment systems; not consumer credit checks: see consumer credit bureau data.

name: Consumer credit bureau data
desc: Credit bureau reports, scores and checks on private individuals for lending decisions, affordability assessments and account monitoring.

name: Business information and company credit reports
desc: Company credit reports, payment behaviour, financial statements and insolvency notices on businesses for credit decisions and supplier or client checks, including supplier and third-party risk data.

name: ESG ratings and data
desc: ESG scores, controversy data and sustainability disclosures on issuers and counterparties for investment, lending and regulatory reporting such as SFDR.

name: Climate and physical risk data
desc: Emissions, carbon footprint, flood and other physical risk data for portfolios and collateral; not advice on climate risk: see climate risk advisory.

name: Alternative data sets
desc: Non-traditional data sets such as card spending, satellite imagery, web traffic and sentiment data used for research and trading signals.

name: Investment research
desc: Broker and independent research on equities, credit, FX and macro, including research paid for under MiFID II unbundling rules.

name: Company fundamentals and estimates data
desc: Company financial statements, fundamentals, consensus estimates and ownership data delivered as feeds for analysis and models; not credit reports: see business information.

name: News feeds and newswires
desc: Real-time and archived news, newswire and machine-readable news feeds for dealing rooms, communications teams and news analytics.

name: Industry analyst research subscriptions
desc: Subscriptions to industry analyst and advisory research on technology, banking and payments markets; not bespoke surveys or customer research: see marketing research.

name: Press and publication subscriptions
desc: Newspapers, magazines, trade journals and online news paywall subscriptions for individuals or teams, in print or digital.

name: Index data licences
desc: Licences for index levels, constituents and weightings used for performance measurement, risk and client reporting; not using an index to issue products.

name: Index-linked product licences
desc: Licences to use an index or benchmark as the underlying of structured notes, funds, ETFs or derivatives the bank issues, including benchmark rate licences.

name: Sanctions and watchlist data
desc: Sanctions, embargo and watchlist data files feeding payment and client screening; not screening software: see AML and sanctions screening software.

name: PEP and adverse media data
desc: Politically exposed person profiles, relatives and close associates, and adverse media data used in KYC onboarding and reviews; not outsourced KYC work: see financial crime and KYC operations.

name: Economic and statistical data
desc: Macroeconomic indicators, forecasts, country risk and official statistics data sets for economics research, stress testing and planning.

name: Property price and housing data
desc: House price indices, property transaction records and automated valuation model results used for mortgage lending and collateral revaluation.

name: Management and strategy consulting
desc: Corporate and business strategy, strategic reviews, market entry and board-level advisory for business areas; not technology or regulatory advice: see the specialist consulting categories.

name: Technology consulting
desc: Advice on technology strategy, IT operating model and technology change where no specific technology consulting category fits; not delivery of IT work: see IT services.

name: Operating model design
desc: Design of target operating models, governance, location strategy and service delivery models for divisions or functions, including blueprints and implementation roadmaps.

name: Business process improvement
desc: Process mapping, lean and six sigma reviews, automation opportunity assessments and end-to-end process redesign; not building automations: see application services.

name: Cost transformation consulting
desc: Cost reduction programmes, cost benchmarking, zero-based budgeting and efficiency diagnostics across the bank or a single division.

name: Customer experience consulting
desc: Customer journey design, client experience research and channel strategy for retail, private and corporate banking; not marketing campaigns: see marketing.

name: IT strategy and enterprise architecture
desc: IT strategy, enterprise and solution architecture reviews, application portfolio rationalisation and technology vendor selection advice.

name: Cyber and ICT risk advisory
desc: Advice on cyber strategy, ICT risk frameworks, DORA readiness and resilience programmes; not penetration tests, security operations or assessments: see cyber security services.

name: Regulatory change consulting
desc: Interpretation and implementation of new banking regulation such as CRR, MiCA or Basel rules, including gap analyses and regulatory change programmes.

name: Risk management consulting
desc: Design and review of credit, market, liquidity and operational risk frameworks, risk appetite and risk governance; not independent model validation.

name: Financial crime compliance advisory
desc: Advice on AML, sanctions and anti-bribery frameworks, financial crime risk assessments and monitor remediation plans; not outsourced alert handling or KYC files: see financial crime operations.

name: Capital and prudential advisory
desc: Support on ICAAP, ILAAP, stress testing, recovery and resolution planning and supervisory reviews such as SREP findings.

name: Finance function transformation
desc: Finance operating model, close and reporting process improvement, finance data and IFRS reporting change programmes; not accounting opinions: see accounting advisory.

name: Treasury and ALM advisory
desc: Advice on asset and liability management, funding and liquidity strategy, interest rate risk in the banking book and funds transfer pricing.

name: Organisation design consulting
desc: Organisation structure design, spans and layers reviews, culture programmes and workforce planning for divisions and functions.

name: Reward and compensation consulting
desc: Advice on pay structures, incentive plans, remuneration policy and material risk taker rules; not salary survey subscriptions: see compensation benchmarking surveys.

name: Procurement and supply chain consulting
desc: Procurement transformation, category strategies, spend analysis and sourcing support for specific events, plus third-party risk framework design.

name: M&A and corporate finance advisory
desc: Buy-side and sell-side M&A advice, fairness opinions, capital raising and strategic options for the bank's own corporate transactions.

name: Transaction due diligence
desc: Financial, commercial and operational due diligence on acquisition targets or partners; not client KYC due diligence; for business valuations see valuation services.

name: Post-merger integration consulting
desc: Integration planning, day-one readiness, separation and carve-out support for acquisitions, mergers and disposals.

name: Programme and project management office
desc: Programme management, PMO set-up and running, project assurance and portfolio reporting delivered by a consultancy team; not individual contractors: see contingent workforce.

name: Organisational change management
desc: Change impact assessments, stakeholder engagement, change communications and adoption support for large programmes and restructurings.

name: Data strategy and governance consulting
desc: Data strategy, data governance and ownership models, data quality frameworks and BCBS 239 compliance advice; not data engineering: see data and AI services.

name: AI and analytics advisory
desc: Advice on AI strategy, use-case prioritisation, responsible AI and analytics operating models; not building models or pipelines: see data and AI services.

name: Sustainability and ESG advisory
desc: Sustainability strategy, net-zero target setting, CSRD and taxonomy reporting readiness and sustainable finance framework advice; not ESG data: see ESG ratings and data.

name: Climate risk advisory
desc: Climate and environmental risk integration into risk frameworks, climate scenario analysis and ECB climate expectations; not emissions data: see climate and physical risk data.

name: Model validation and review
desc: Independent validation of credit, market, pricing and AI models, model risk framework reviews and regulatory model approval support such as TRIM.

name: Actuarial consulting
desc: Actuarial valuations of pension obligations, insurance-related reserves and longevity risk, including IAS 19 pension reports for the annual accounts.

name: Legal services (general counsel support)
desc: General external legal advice, secondments of lawyers and ad hoc counsel where no specialist legal category fits; not notary or debt recovery work.

name: Corporate and M&A legal advice
desc: Legal advice on acquisitions, disposals, joint ventures, corporate governance and company secretarial matters for the bank's own group entities.

name: Banking and finance law
desc: Legal advice and documentation for lending, syndicated and leveraged loans, structured and trade finance, and security and guarantee packages.

name: Litigation and dispute resolution
desc: Representation in court proceedings, arbitration and mediation, including pre-litigation advice and class actions; not routine debt recovery: see debt recovery legal services.

name: Regulatory and investigations counsel
desc: Legal advice on supervisory matters, regulatory enforcement, internal investigations and whistleblowing cases; not regulatory implementation consulting: see regulatory change consulting.

name: Employment law advice
desc: Legal advice on employment contracts, dismissals, works council negotiations, collective agreements and employment tribunal cases; not HR consulting.

name: Real estate law
desc: Legal advice on office leases, property acquisitions and disposals, lease renewals and landlord disputes for bank premises.

name: IP and technology law
desc: Legal advice on technology, outsourcing and cloud contracts, software licensing, trademarks and other intellectual property matters.

name: Data protection and privacy law
desc: Legal advice on GDPR compliance, data transfers, data processing agreements, data breach notifications and privacy impact assessments.

name: Notary services
desc: Notarial certification of signatures, deeds, powers of attorney and company register filings, including apostilles and land register entries.

name: Legal process outsourcing
desc: Outsourced high-volume legal work such as contract review, document review for disclosure and legal data extraction, run by an LPO provider.

name: Debt recovery legal services
desc: Lawyers and legal agents enforcing overdue loans and claims through court orders, enforcement and insolvency filings; not pre-legal collections: see collections.

name: Capital markets and securities law
desc: Legal advice on bond and covered bond issuance, prospectuses, debt issuance programmes, securitisation and listing requirements for the bank's own funding.

name: Restructuring and insolvency law
desc: Legal advice on borrower restructurings, workouts, insolvency proceedings and creditor committees for distressed exposures; not routine debt enforcement.

name: Netting and collateral opinions
desc: Industry and bespoke legal opinions on close-out netting and collateral enforceability across jurisdictions, used for capital relief and ISDA documentation.

name: Statutory audit
desc: Annual statutory and group audit of financial statements by the appointed external auditor, including half-year reviews and regulatory audit reports.

name: ISAE 3402 and SOC reports
desc: Independent assurance reports on controls at the bank or its service providers, such as ISAE 3402, SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports.

name: Other assurance engagements
desc: Agreed-upon procedures, limited assurance on non-financial or ESG reports, deposit guarantee and client asset assurance reports outside the statutory audit.

name: Internal audit co-sourcing
desc: External audit specialists working within the bank's internal audit plan, for example IT, model or regulatory audits, under co-sourcing or outsourcing arrangements.

name: Tax compliance
desc: Preparation and filing of corporate tax returns, withholding tax reclaims and FATCA and CRS reporting support for group entities.

name: Tax advisory
desc: Advice on corporate tax, tax structuring of products and transactions, tax audits by authorities and tax rulings; not tax disputes in court: see litigation and dispute resolution.

name: Transfer pricing
desc: Transfer pricing policies, intra-group pricing benchmarks, master and local file documentation and advance pricing agreements for group entities.

name: VAT advisory and compliance
desc: VAT and indirect tax advice, VAT returns, partial exemption and recovery rate calculations and cross-border VAT questions for the bank.

name: Accounting advisory
desc: Technical accounting opinions and implementation support for IFRS 9, IFRS 16 and other standards, plus accounting policy reviews; not finance transformation programmes.

name: Forensic accounting and investigations
desc: Forensic accountants investigating fraud, misconduct or financial irregularities, including data analytics, evidence preservation and expert witness reports.

name: Valuation services
desc: Independent valuations of businesses, participations, intangible assets and purchase price allocations for accounting, tax or transaction purposes.

name: Audit, tax and accounting services (other)
desc: Audit, tax and accounting work from specialist firms that no specific audit, tax or accounting category covers, such as one-off certifications.

name: Training and learning (other)
desc: External training courses, workshops and learning activities that no specific learning category covers. Not internal events or conferences we host: see Marketing and events.

name: Leadership development
desc: Leadership and management development programmes for new, middle and senior managers, including business school executive education. Individual coaching: see Executive and team coaching.

name: Compliance and regulatory e-learning
desc: Off-the-shelf e-learning modules on regulatory topics such as AML, MiFID, market abuse and data protection, licensed per user. Bespoke risk courses: see Mandatory risk training programmes.

name: IT and technical training
desc: Instructor-led or virtual courses on technology topics such as cloud, programming, data, cyber security and vendor products, including lab access.

name: Language training
desc: Language courses for employees, delivered one-to-one, in groups or online, including business English and local language lessons for expatriates.

name: Professional certifications and exam fees
desc: Fees for professional qualifications, exam registrations and certification programmes such as CFA, ACCA, PMP or IT vendor certifications.

name: Executive and team coaching
desc: One-to-one executive coaching and team coaching by accredited external coaches. Group leadership programmes: see Leadership development; career transition coaching: see Outplacement and career transition.

name: E-learning content libraries
desc: Subscriptions to off-the-shelf online course libraries and learning content catalogues. Not the learning management system software: see Software.

name: Graduate programme training
desc: Structured training curricula for graduate and trainee programmes, such as induction academies and rotational bootcamps. Hiring graduate temps: see External workforce.

name: Conference attendance fees
desc: Registration fees for employees attending external conferences, summits and trade fairs as delegates. Events we host or sponsor: see Marketing and events.

name: Sales and client relationship training
desc: Training in sales techniques, negotiation, client relationship and advisory conversations for front-office, branch and relationship manager staff.

name: Mandatory risk training programmes
desc: Bespoke or instructor-led mandatory courses on operational risk, conduct, fraud awareness and information security built around our policies. Off-the-shelf modules: see Compliance and regulatory e-learning.

name: Banking and financial markets training
desc: Technical banking courses on credit analysis, financial modelling, derivatives, treasury and capital markets for front-office, risk and finance staff.

name: Personal effectiveness and soft skills training
desc: Courses on communication, presentation, time planning, resilience and other personal effectiveness skills for employees at any level.

name: Contingent workforce and contractors
desc: External workers who work under our direction and supervision, billed by time, where no more specific contingent category fits. Not delivery of a defined outcome: see Consulting or IT services.

name: Recruitment and HR services (other)
desc: Recruitment and HR services from external firms that no specific HR services category covers. Not HR software: see Software; not HR consulting projects: see Consulting.

name: Temporary agency staff
desc: Temporary staff supplied by a staffing agency under temporary agency work rules, for example to cover absence or peak workload in operations or administration.

name: Interim managers
desc: Experienced interim managers or executives placed through an agency to fill a leadership role temporarily under our direction. Permanent executive hires: see Executive search.

name: IT contractors
desc: Individual IT specialists such as developers, testers, architects or analysts working in our teams under our direction, billed by day rate.

name: MSP and VMS services
desc: Managed service programme and vendor management software for sourcing, onboarding and invoicing contingent workers across agencies. Not the workers' own day rates: see the worker categories.

name: Statement-of-work freelancers
desc: Independent freelancers engaged on a short statement of work for a defined deliverable while embedded in our teams, such as designers or writers.

name: Student and graduate temps
desc: Students, interns and recent graduates hired on temporary contracts through an agency for internships, summer work or short project help. Graduate training programmes: see Learning.

name: Payrolling of sourced workers
desc: Agency payrolling of workers we have found ourselves, where the agency employs and pays them but adds no recruitment. Recruiting new temps: see Temporary agency staff.

name: Recruitment agencies
desc: Contingency or retained agency fees for filling permanent positions below executive level. Temporary staff: see External workforce; senior leadership hires: see Executive search.

name: Executive search
desc: Retained search for board members, senior executives and key leadership roles, including market mapping and candidate assessment for shortlisted candidates.

name: Recruitment process outsourcing
desc: A provider runs all or part of our recruitment process, including sourcing, screening and interview scheduling, for volume or programme hiring.

name: Background screening
desc: Pre-employment and periodic screening of candidates and staff, including identity, criminal record, credit, employment history and fit-and-proper checks.

name: Relocation and global mobility
desc: Relocation, immigration and assignment services for employees moving to new locations, including home finding, work permits and tax equalisation coordination. Business trip visas: see Travel.

name: Outplacement and career transition
desc: Career transition programmes for employees leaving through restructuring, such as job search coaching, CV workshops and placement assistance.

name: Employee assistance programme
desc: Confidential counselling and advice lines for employees and their families on personal, mental health, legal and financial issues, available around the clock.

name: Occupational health
desc: Occupational physician services, fitness-for-work assessments, health surveillance and workstation ergonomic assessments. Not on-site first-aid or safety services: see Facilities.

name: Benefits administration
desc: Third-party administration of employee benefit schemes such as pensions, flexible benefits and bike leasing. Not the insurance cover itself: see Insurance; not HR administration outsourcing: see Business process services.

name: Employer branding
desc: Employer brand strategy, careers content, job advertising campaigns and recruitment marketing aimed at candidates. Not consumer brand campaigns: see Marketing.

name: Assessment centres and psychometric testing
desc: Design and delivery of assessment centres, psychometric and aptitude tests, and personality assessments for candidate selection or employee development.

name: Payroll advisory
desc: Expert advice on payroll compliance, tax and social security treatment and payroll audits. Not running the payroll itself: see Payroll processing; not payroll software: see Software.

name: Compensation benchmarking surveys
desc: Salary and reward benchmarking surveys, pay data and participation fees for compensation studies used to set pay ranges and bonus levels.

name: Employee engagement surveys
desc: Externally run employee engagement, pulse and exit surveys, including survey design, analysis and benchmarking against peers. Not survey software licences only: see Software.

name: Business process services (other)
desc: Outsourced business processes run by a provider on our behalf that no specific operations category covers. Not consulting projects or staff under our direction: see Consulting or External workforce.

name: Financial crime and KYC operations
desc: Outsourced KYC and customer due diligence operations, such as onboarding file preparation, document collection and EDD checks. Not KYC software: see Software; not a one-off KYC consulting project: see Consulting.

name: Payments and banking operations
desc: Outsourced payment processing operations, such as payment repair, exception handling and investigations, plus general banking back-office work not covered by a more specific category.

name: AML investigations
desc: Outsourced level-two anti-money laundering investigations of escalated cases, including case narratives and draft suspicious activity reports for our MLRO to decide on.

name: Sanctions alert handling
desc: Outsourced review and disposition of sanctions name-screening and payment-screening hits against our procedures. Not sanctions list data: see Market data; not screening software: see Software.

name: Transaction monitoring alert review
desc: Level-one review and closure or escalation of transaction monitoring alerts generated by our monitoring tools, performed by an outsourced operations team.

name: KYC periodic reviews
desc: Outsourced periodic refresh of existing client KYC files on the risk-based review cycle, including outreach to clients and updating due diligence records.

name: KYC remediation operations
desc: Outsourced remediation of back-book KYC files to close gaps found by audit or regulators, run as a time-bound operations team rather than advisory work.

name: Fraud operations and case handling
desc: Outsourced fraud alert handling, customer fraud claims processing and case administration. Not fraud detection software: see Software; not forensic investigations: see Audit and tax.

name: Trade finance operations
desc: Outsourced document checking and processing for letters of credit, guarantees, collections and supply chain finance transactions handled on our behalf.

name: Corporate actions processing
desc: Outsourced capture, notification and processing of corporate action events such as dividends, coupons, splits and elections for client and house securities positions.

name: Reconciliation operations
desc: Outsourced cash, securities, nostro and intersystem reconciliation work, including break investigation and resolution. Not reconciliation software licences: see Software.

name: Cash and securities settlement operations
desc: Outsourced settlement processing for securities trades and cash movements, including matching, fails handling and standing settlement instruction upkeep on our behalf.

name: Mortgage and loan processing
desc: Outsourced mortgage and consumer or business loan processing, such as application handling, underwriting preparation, drawdowns and servicing. Not credit decisioning software: see Software.

name: Fund administration
desc: Third-party fund administration for funds we manage or sponsor, including NAV calculation, fund accounting, transfer agency and investor servicing.

name: Card disputes and chargeback processing
desc: Outsourced processing of cardholder disputes, chargebacks and retrieval requests within card scheme rules. Scheme fees themselves: see Financial market infrastructure.

name: Cheque and paper payment processing
desc: Outsourced clearing preparation, imaging and exception handling for cheques and other paper payment instruments received by branches or post.

name: FATCA and CRS reporting operations
desc: Outsourced preparation and data validation for FATCA and CRS tax reporting on client accounts. Not tax advice on the rules: see Audit and tax.

name: Collateral and margin operations
desc: Outsourced margin call processing, collateral movements and dispute handling for derivatives, repo and securities lending activity. Not central counterparty fees: see Financial market infrastructure.

name: Accounts payable processing
desc: Outsourced supplier invoice processing, matching, payment runs and vendor master data maintenance. Not procure-to-pay software: see Software.

name: Payroll processing
desc: Outsourced monthly payroll calculation, payslips and statutory filings run by a provider. Not payroll software: see Software; not payroll advice: see HR services.

name: Travel and expense claims processing
desc: Outsourced checking, auditing and processing of employee travel and expense claims. Not travel booking: see Travel; not expense software: see Software.

name: HR administration outsourcing
desc: Outsourced HR administration such as employee records, contract letters, joiner-mover-leaver processing and HR helpdesk. Not recruitment or HR advice: see HR services.

name: Accounts receivable and billing operations
desc: Outsourced customer billing, invoicing of fees, cash application and credit control for receivables. Not retail customer debt collection: see Collections and recovery operations.

name: Record-to-report and general ledger operations
desc: Outsourced general ledger postings, month-end close tasks, balance sheet substantiation and intercompany accounting. Not audit or accounting advice: see Audit and tax.

name: Contact centre outsourcing
desc: Outsourced inbound and outbound customer contact handling by phone, chat and email. Not telephony or contact centre technology: see Telecom or Software.

name: Collections and recovery operations
desc: Outsourced early and late-stage arrears collection, debt recovery calls and debt sale preparation. Not court proceedings by lawyers: see Legal debt recovery.

name: Complaints handling operations
desc: Outsourced handling, investigation and response drafting for customer complaints, including ombudsman case preparation, under our complaints policy.

name: Account servicing back office
desc: Outsourced customer account maintenance such as address changes, power of attorney, account closures and standing order amendments, received by mail or online.

name: Bereavement and deceased estates processing
desc: Outsourced handling of deceased customer notifications, estate account administration and release of funds to executors, following our bereavement procedures.

name: Document scanning and digitisation
desc: Outsourced scanning, indexing and digitisation of paper documents and back files. Not scanners or capture software: see IT hardware or Software.

name: Print and mail outsourcing
desc: Outsourced composition, printing, enveloping and posting of customer letters and notices, including hybrid mail. Not internal mailroom or postage: see Facilities.

name: Customer statement printing
desc: High-volume printing and dispatch of account statements, card statements and annual tax certificates. Not one-off marketing mailings: see Marketing direct mail.

name: Records management and archiving
desc: Outsourced records lifecycle operations: indexing, retention scheduling, retrieval on request and legal hold for paper and electronic records. Not basic box storage space: see Facilities.

name: Data capture and form processing
desc: Outsourced keying and validation of data from forms, applications and correspondence into our applications. Not document scanning itself: see Document scanning and digitisation.

name: Card scheme fees
desc: Membership, assessment, processing and licence fees charged by international and domestic card schemes for our issuing and acquiring. Not card dispute outsourcing: see Business process services.

name: SEPA scheme participation fees
desc: Adherence and participation fees for SEPA credit transfer, direct debit and instant schemes paid to the scheme manager. Clearing fees for those payments: see the clearing categories.

name: Automated clearing house fees
desc: Fees charged by retail payment clearing houses (ACH) for clearing and settling bulk credit transfers and direct debits on our behalf.

name: Instant payments clearing fees
desc: Participation and transaction fees for real-time payment clearing and settlement infrastructures, including instant payment settlement at the central bank.

name: High-value payment system (RTGS) fees
desc: Participation, transaction and liquidity tool fees for the central bank real-time gross settlement system used for large-value euro payments.

name: Central counterparty clearing fees
desc: Clearing, membership and default fund related fees charged by central counterparties for cleared derivatives, repo and cash equities. Not margin operations outsourcing: see Business process services.

name: Central securities depository fees
desc: Account, safekeeping, settlement and asset-servicing fees charged directly by central and international securities depositories where we are a participant.

name: Sub-custody and agent bank fees
desc: Fees paid to sub-custodians and local agent banks for holding and settling securities in markets where we are not a direct depository participant.

name: SWIFT messaging fees
desc: Membership, messaging traffic and connectivity fees for the interbank financial messaging network, including ISO 20022 traffic. Third-party hosted connections: see SWIFT service bureau.

name: SWIFT service bureau
desc: Third-party bureau that hosts and operates our SWIFT connectivity, interfaces and security controls on our behalf. Network traffic fees: see SWIFT messaging fees.

name: Correspondent banking fees
desc: Fees and charges paid to correspondent banks for nostro accounts, foreign currency clearing and cross-border payment routing on our behalf.

name: Stock exchange and trading venue fees
desc: Membership, trading, connectivity and listing-related fees charged by stock exchanges, MTFs and other trading venues. Not market data licences: see Market data.

name: Trade repository and reporting hub fees
desc: Fees for trade repositories, approved reporting mechanisms and regulatory reporting hubs used for EMIR, MiFIR and SFTR transaction reporting. Not reporting software: see Software.

name: Directors' and officers' liability insurance
desc: Insurance protecting directors and officers against personal liability claims arising from their decisions, including side A, B and C cover.

name: Professional indemnity insurance
desc: Civil liability or professional indemnity cover for claims arising from errors or negligence in the financial services we provide to clients.

name: Property and business interruption insurance
desc: Insurance for our buildings, contents and IT equipment against physical damage, plus resulting business interruption losses. Not cyber incidents: see Cyber insurance.

name: Cyber insurance
desc: Cover for losses from cyber incidents such as data breaches, ransomware and network outages, including incident response costs. Not cyber security services: see IT services.

name: Crime and bankers' blanket bond
desc: Bankers' blanket bond and crime cover for losses from employee dishonesty, forgery, theft and computer crime affecting bank and client assets.

name: Group life and health insurance
desc: Employee benefits insurance such as group life, disability, private medical and dental cover bought for staff. Not benefits administration: see HR services.

name: Business travel insurance
desc: Annual corporate travel insurance covering employees on business trips for medical emergencies, evacuation, baggage and trip disruption. Not travel risk services: see Travel.

name: Motor fleet insurance
desc: Insurance covering company cars, pool vehicles and other fleet vehicles for liability, damage and theft. Not car leasing: see Travel and fleet.

name: Insurance broker services
desc: Broker fees or commission for placing, renewing and claims advocacy across our corporate insurance programme. Not the premiums themselves: see the specific insurance category.

name: Events and hospitality
desc: Planning and running bank-hosted events and hospitality such as client dinners, receptions, roadshows and staff parties, including event agencies and entertainers; venue hire alone sits under conferences and venues.

name: Conferences and venues
desc: Hire of conference centres, hotel function rooms and external venues for bank events or offsites; not tickets for staff to attend third-party conferences, which are learning.

name: Client entertainment and tickets
desc: Tickets and hospitality packages for sporting, cultural and music events used to entertain clients, subject to the gifts and entertainment policy; not sponsorship rights.

name: Sponsorship
desc: Sponsorship rights for sports teams, cultural institutions, arts and community events, including naming rights and activation fees; not charitable donations or one-off client tickets.

name: Print advertising
desc: Advertisement placements in newspapers, magazines, trade journals and printed directories, including ad production fees; not direct mail letters sent to clients.

name: Outdoor advertising
desc: Out-of-home advertising such as billboards, posters, transit advertising, airport displays and digital screens in public spaces; not signage on bank branches.

name: TV and radio advertising
desc: Broadcast advertising airtime on television, radio, streaming audio and cinema, including spot production; not video content made for our website or social channels.

name: Media buying and planning
desc: Media agency fees for planning and buying advertising space across channels, including programmatic buying and media audits; not the creative work behind the ads.

name: Digital marketing and performance
desc: Paid search, display and affiliate campaigns, search engine optimisation and conversion tracking run by a digital agency; not website building or organic social posting.

name: Social media agency
desc: Agencies that plan and create organic social media content, community moderation and influencer collaborations on LinkedIn, Instagram and similar channels; not paid search campaigns.

name: Creative agency
desc: Creative agencies developing campaign concepts, copywriting, key visuals and advertising artwork; not media buying, brand identity redesigns or standalone photo and video shoots.

name: PR and communications agency
desc: Public relations and communications agencies for press relations, media monitoring, crisis communications and executive positioning; not internal staff communication tools.

name: Brand design and identity
desc: Brand strategy, logo and visual identity design, brand guidelines and naming work; not production of branded stationery or business cards, which are office supplies.

name: Website and content production
desc: Production of marketing website pages, landing pages, articles, newsletters and copy for digital channels; not development of online banking or customer applications.

name: Photography and video production
desc: Photo shoots, corporate video, explainer animations, podcasts and event filming, including image licences and stock photography; not TV advertising spots.

name: Marketing research and surveys
desc: Customer surveys, brand tracking, focus groups, net promoter score studies and market sizing research; not financial market research or analyst reports.

name: Direct mail campaigns
desc: Design, personalisation and dispatch of marketing letters, flyers and inserts to prospects and clients; not statutory statements or transactional print and mail operations.

name: Promotional merchandise
desc: Logo-branded giveaways for events and campaigns such as pens, tote bags, lanyards and drinkware; not personal gifts to named clients and not staff uniforms.

name: Client gifts
desc: Individual gifts for named clients and partners such as hampers, wine and seasonal presents, subject to the gifts policy; not mass-produced branded giveaways.

name: Exhibition stands and displays
desc: Design, build, transport and storage of trade fair stands, pop-up displays and roll-up banners for exhibitions; not permanent building signage.

name: Event production and audiovisual
desc: Stage, lighting, sound and AV equipment hire, live streaming and hybrid event production for bank events; not permanent meeting room video conferencing equipment.

name: Loyalty and rewards programmes
desc: Customer loyalty schemes, cashback and points programmes, reward catalogues and fulfilment of rewards to retail and card clients; not staff benefits.

name: Integrated facility management
desc: Single contract bundling soft and hard facility services across sites under one managing supplier; use the specific L4 when buying one service on its own.

name: Office cleaning
desc: Routine daily and periodic cleaning of offices, branches and common areas, including consumables supplied by the cleaner; not window, facade or specialist deep cleaning.

name: Window and facade cleaning
desc: Internal and external window cleaning, facade washing, rope access and cradle work on bank buildings; not routine office cleaning inside the premises.

name: Specialist and deep cleaning
desc: Carpet and upholstery shampooing, post-construction cleaning, kitchen extraction cleaning and biohazard or infection disinfection; not daily office cleaning.

name: Washroom hygiene
desc: Rental and servicing of sanitary bins, hand dryers, soap and fragrance dispensers and hygiene units in washrooms; not bulk paper towels bought as supplies.

name: Staff restaurant catering
desc: Operation of staff canteens, cafés and coffee bars on bank premises by a contract caterer, including subsidy arrangements; not client event catering.

name: Vending and micro-markets
desc: Snack and drinks vending machines, unattended micro-markets and coffee machine rental with ingredient refills; not catered meals or bottled water coolers.

name: Meeting room catering
desc: Internal meeting catering such as sandwich platters, working lunches and refreshments delivered to bank meeting rooms; not client hospitality events, which are marketing.

name: Water coolers and dispensers
desc: Rental, sanitising and refills of bottled and mains-fed water coolers and sparkling water dispensers; not building water supply or pantry drink purchases.

name: Security guarding
desc: Manned guarding of offices, branches and data centres, including static guards, mobile patrols and event security; not alarm monitoring centres or cash transport.

name: Alarm monitoring and keyholding
desc: Remote intruder and panic alarm monitoring, alarm response and keyholding for branches and empty buildings; not on-site guards or CCTV hardware maintenance.

name: Access control and CCTV maintenance
desc: Installation, maintenance and repair of door access readers, turnstiles, badge printers and CCTV cameras in bank buildings; not identity software or logical access.

name: Cash-in-transit and ATM servicing
desc: Security logistics: armoured cash transport between branches and cash centres, ATM replenishment, first-line ATM fault fixing and cash processing; not ATM hardware purchases.

name: Reception and front-of-house
desc: Receptionists, visitor greeting and registration, switchboard staff, concierge and meeting room hosts at bank offices; not security guards or visitor booking software.

name: Indoor plants and decoration
desc: Rental and care of indoor plants, green walls, artwork rental and seasonal decorations in offices and branches; not cut flowers or bouquets: see flowers and floral arrangements; not outdoor landscaping.

name: Parking management
desc: Operation of staff and visitor car parks, parking permits, barrier operation, bicycle storage and rented parking spaces; not company car leasing or EV charging energy.

name: Building maintenance and repairs
desc: Planned and reactive maintenance of building fabric, plumbing, doors, roofs and minor repairs, including handyman call-outs; not refurbishment projects or specialist plant.

name: HVAC maintenance
desc: Servicing and repair of heating, ventilation, air conditioning, chillers and boilers, including F-gas checks and filter changes; not the heating energy itself.

name: Lift and escalator maintenance
desc: Maintenance contracts, statutory inspections, emergency call-outs and modernisation of lifts, escalators, dumbwaiters and goods hoists in bank buildings.

name: Electrical maintenance and testing
desc: Maintenance of building electrical installations, lighting repairs, portable appliance testing and periodic electrical inspections; not fire alarms or standby generators.

name: Fire safety systems maintenance
desc: Inspection and servicing of fire alarms, sprinklers, extinguishers, emergency lighting and smoke ventilation, including fire risk assessments; not fire warden training courses.

name: Standby power and UPS maintenance
desc: Maintenance and load testing of building standby generators, uninterruptible power supplies and fuel top-ups for critical sites; not data centre hardware purchases.

name: Waste and recycling
desc: Collection and disposal of general, food, recyclable and hazardous waste from offices and branches, including bins and waste reporting; not confidential paper shredding or IT disposal.

name: Landscaping and grounds maintenance
desc: Gardening, grounds upkeep, tree surgery, outdoor planters, winter gritting and snow clearance around bank premises; not indoor plants or decoration.

name: Pest control
desc: Preventive and reactive pest control for rodents, insects and birds, including bait stations, bird proofing and inspection reports at bank sites.

name: Energy management services
desc: Energy audits, building energy monitoring, sub-metering, optimisation of building controls and energy performance certificates; not purchase of electricity or gas, nor energy brokerage.

name: Office moves and relocations
desc: Removal companies for office moves, desk and crate moves, internal churn and furniture storage during relocations; not employee home relocation or international mobility.

name: Workplace fit-out and refurbishment
desc: Design and build of office fit-outs, branch refurbishments, partitioning, flooring, ceilings and decorating projects; not routine repairs or loose furniture purchases.

name: Furniture installation
desc: Assembly, installation, reconfiguration and disposal of desks, workstations, storage and meeting room furniture; not the purchase of the furniture itself.

name: Mailroom operations
desc: On-site mailroom staff sorting and distributing incoming, outgoing and internal mail and parcels; not bulk print and mail of client statements, which is business process services.

name: Courier and express delivery
desc: Same-day couriers, motorbike and bicycle couriers, and international express shipping of documents and parcels; not standard letter post or franking.

name: Postal services and franking
desc: Standard and registered letter post, postal contracts, franking machines and PO boxes with national postal operators; not courier or express parcel delivery.

name: Confidential document shredding
desc: Secure collection, on-site or off-site shredding and certified destruction of confidential paper from console bins; not destruction of IT hardware or data media.

name: Physical archive storage
desc: Warehouse storage, transport and retrieval of physical archive boxes, deeds and files; not outsourced records operations with indexing and scanning, which are business process services.

name: Occupational safety services
desc: External safety specialists, workplace risk assessments, display screen assessments and statutory health and safety inspections; not occupational health doctors, which are HR services.

name: Legionella and water hygiene testing
desc: Legionella risk assessments, water sampling, tank cleaning and temperature monitoring of building water installations to meet hygiene rules; not water supply bills.

name: Office supplies (other)
desc: Office consumables not covered by a more specific office category, bought through catalogue or punch-out; check stationery, paper and toner, and pantry first.

name: Stationery
desc: Pens, notebooks, folders, staplers, sticky notes, binders and other everyday writing and filing items for desks; not branded business cards or letterheads.

name: Printer paper and toner
desc: Copier and printer paper, toner cartridges, ink and drums for office printers and multifunction devices; not printer hardware or managed print contracts.

name: Branded business cards and letterheads
desc: Printing of employee business cards, letterheads, compliment slips and branded envelopes to corporate design; not marketing brochures or direct mail campaigns.

name: Kitchen and pantry supplies
desc: Coffee, tea, milk, fruit, sugar, disposable cups and dishwasher products for office kitchens and pantries; not catered meals or vending machines.

name: First-aid supplies
desc: First-aid kits, refills, eye wash stations, burn kits and defibrillator pads for offices and branches; not occupational health or safety inspections.

name: Desk accessories
desc: Desk organisers, document trays, desk lamps, whiteboards, flipcharts, noticeboards and wall clocks for workspaces; not ergonomic equipment or furniture.

name: Office furniture
desc: Purchase of desks, office chairs, meeting tables, storage cabinets, lockers and soft seating for offices and branches; installation itself sits under facilities.

name: Ergonomic equipment
desc: Sit-stand desk converters, ergonomic chairs prescribed after assessment, footrests, monitor arms, wrist rests and back supports for individual employees.

name: Workwear and uniforms
desc: Uniforms for branch, reception and security staff, protective clothing and safety shoes, including laundering; not logo merchandise given to clients.

name: Signage and wayfinding
desc: Branch fascia signs, internal wayfinding, door and room signs, safety signage and digital signage displays; not advertising billboards or exhibition stands.

name: Small office electricals
desc: Kettles, microwaves, desk fans, heaters, extension leads and other small electrical appliances for offices; not IT hardware or building electrical works.

name: Paper hygiene and cleaning consumables
desc: Paper towels, toilet rolls, hand soap and cleaning chemicals bought directly as goods; not cleaning contracts or washroom hygiene unit rental.

name: Mailing and packaging supplies
desc: Envelopes, padded mailers, cardboard boxes, tape, archive boxes and labels for dispatch and storage; not postage, courier or archive storage.

name: Electricity supply
desc: Supply contracts for grid electricity to offices, branches and data centres, including green tariffs and grid charges; not energy audits or certificates bought separately.

name: Natural gas supply
desc: Natural gas supply contracts for heating and hot water in bank buildings, including network charges and meter fees; not boiler maintenance.

name: Water and wastewater
desc: Mains water supply, sewerage and wastewater charges, and trade effluent fees for bank premises; not water coolers or legionella testing.

name: District heating and cooling
desc: Heat and chilled water supplied through municipal or campus district networks, including connection fees and capacity charges; not on-site boilers or chillers.

name: Energy brokerage and certificates
desc: Energy brokers, tender advice and hedging of energy purchases, plus guarantees of origin and renewable energy certificates; not building energy audits.

name: EV charging energy
desc: Electricity and charge-point roaming fees for charging company and pool electric vehicles at offices, homes and public chargers; not fuel cards for petrol and diesel.

name: Air travel
desc: Business flights, airline corporate agreements, fares, seat and baggage fees and airline change charges for employees; not airport lounge memberships.

name: Hotels and accommodation
desc: Hotel nights, serviced apartments and corporate hotel programmes for business trips and project stays; not venues for conferences or events.

name: Rail travel
desc: Train tickets, rail passes and corporate rail cards for business travel; not local public transport passes provided as employee benefits.

name: Travel management company
desc: Travel agency fees for booking, the online booking tool, traveller profiles and travel spend reporting; not the tickets and hotels themselves.

name: Car rental
